title: Dan Campbell: Penei Sewell's move to left tackle will be "seamless"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell: Penei Sewell's move to left tackle will be "seamless"
sources.description: With the Lions moving on from Taylor Decker earlier this offseason, Penei Sewell is now set to move over to left tackle for the 2026 season.
